about_the_game:
As the day winds down, she's there on your desktop, quietly awaiting your return. Will you choose to spend some special time with your other waifu tonight? (She might just be wearing something special...)

The card table is her stage, reserved just for you. Win each game to unlock enticing outfits, letting your other waifu glow with captivating charm under the evening lights. Can you see that hint of a blush?

Simple keyboard taps and mouse clicks could speed up unlocking your other waifu's next outfit. Every action builds towards gifting her a new look... Want to see her shine even brighter? Feel free to interact as you work or study – she'll be patiently waiting. And when night falls again, she'll be right there on your desktop, ready for your next "secret game".
